name: Clover (United States)
description: Divided horizontally light blue over white, charged near the hoist with a round emblem of a green clover on white within a golden ring reading THE TOWN WITH LOVE IN THE MIDDLE.
history: Clover is a town in York County, South Carolina. Flags of the World records, from the town administration, that the town had no flag by 2010 but that a flag adopted in the mid-1980s by the chamber of commerce or the town is depicted on the town mural; Wikidata dates it 1989 to 2019.
